variant.entry: When previously inactive: close[t] > close[t-20] AND volume[t] > 1.5 * mean(volume[t-20:t]); latest completed day t excluded from volume mean. Equality does not enter.
variant.hold_exit: When previously active: remain active while close[t] > close[t-20], irrespective of current volume. Exit when close[t] <= close[t-20]. No profit target, stop-loss or time exit.
variant.zero_volume_mean: Zero prior mean blocks entry; zero latest volume blocks entry. Neither forces exit of an active trend. Missing/negative/nonfinite volume fails data validation, not an invented zero.
variant.initial_state: Both signal states inactive at first scored decision, independent of starting owned inventory; no pre-scored signal state reconstruction.
variant.allocation: Reuse daily equal-universe 1/N fee-reserved targets, inactive weight stays cash; daily resizing remains possible.
variant.data: Existing admitted Bitstamp BTC/USD and ETH/USD daily OHLCV; volume is venue-specific base volume, normalized separately within each asset.
variant.timing: Only completed available bars, existing publication/processing lags and future daily-open proxies.
variant.parameters_authority: Agent-selected simple working hypothesis after seeing S1, not optimized or a paper replication. No S2 historical signals or returns examined before specification.
variant.budget_slot: Replaces unexecuted TREND-365 reservation, whose old definition remains for provenance; selection cap and multiplicity divisor remain 18.
variant.implementation_reuse: Existing signal interface, data loader, allocator, execution, ledger and reports; no framework migration or third-party code copy.
variant.evaluation_scope: One development pilot only, then reject/inconclusive or register missing robustness before any promotion. Holdout access not authorized.

execution_model: fixed target quantities from prior available closes; future daily open proxy; quote fees; no EUR leg
